intro: Individually bookable experiences rooted in the living traditions of Rishikesh. Join one, or combine a few into your own day by the Ganga.
draft_note: DRAFT copy written from general knowledge of each ritual. Maansi to review and replace with her own words.

experiences.title: Rudrabhishek
experiences.line: A Vedic offering to Lord Shiva.
experiences.image_alt: A temple in the hills above Rishikesh at sunset
experiences.about: Rudrabhishek is one of the oldest rituals of devotion to Lord Shiva. The Shiva lingam is bathed with offerings such as water, milk, curd, honey and ghee while the Rudram mantras are chanted.
expect: The ritual is guided by a pandit.
You take part in the offerings yourself.
Time to sit quietly with the chanting.

experiences.title: Havan by the Ganga
experiences.line: A sacred fire ritual beside the river.
experiences.image_alt: Guests in marigold garlands offering into the havan fire
experiences.about: A havan is a traditional fire ritual. Seated around the sacred fire, participants offer herbs, grains and ghee into the flames with each mantra, as an act of gratitude and intention.
expect: Seated around the fire with the group.
Each offering made with a mantra.

experiences.title: Ganga Aarti Experience
experiences.line: Evening lamps, chants and bells on the river.
experiences.image_alt: The temples on the riverbank lit up in the evening
experiences.about: As the light fades, lamps are raised to the Ganga with chants, bells and songs of devotion. Experiencing the aarti together is one of the most moving moments of a day in Rishikesh.
expect: Arrive before sunset to settle in.
Join the chanting, or simply watch.
A short walk by the river afterwards.

experiences.title: Ganga Snan & Deep Daan
experiences.line: A holy dip, and a lamp offered to the river.
experiences.about: Ganga Snan is a mindful dip in the sacred river. Deep Daan is the offering of a small leaf lamp with flowers, set afloat on the water with a prayer or an intention.
expect: A guided, unhurried dip at a safe spot.
Making and offering your own deep.
A moment of stillness by the water.

experiences.title: Seva & Annadan Experience
experiences.line: Service, and the offering of food.
experiences.about: Seva is selfless service. Annadan, the offering of food, is considered one of the highest forms of giving. Together you prepare and serve a meal, as an act of compassion.
expect: Helping prepare and serve a meal.
